lastGame.title: Bills 31, Jets 12
stats: Josh Allen: 11-of-21, 196 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT; 2 rushing TDs (both 1 yard); passed Peyton Manning for most total TDs in a player's first 10 seasons
James Cook III: 18 carries, 157 yards, 74-yard TD run (career long, Bills' longest rushing TD since 2016)
DJ Moore: 4 catches, 90 yards, 45-yard TD; Dalton Kincaid had a career-long 54-yard catch
Defense: no TDs allowed, Jets 3-of-13 on third down; T.J. Parker 2 sacks, Dorian Williams first career sack
Jets QBs: Geno Smith 13-of-21, 148 yards before an ankle injury; rookie Cade Klubnik 11-of-20, 137 yards, 1 INT

news.h: Benford, Alford, Williams and Kincaid sit out Wednesday
news.b: The Bills opened Miami week with a walk-through on Wednesday. CB Christian Benford (groin), CB Dee Alford (concussion), LB Dorian Williams (calf), TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) and G O'Cyrus Torrence (personal) did not take part. Safeties Cole Bishop, Amani Hooker and Damar Hamlin were limited, and head coach Joe Brady said he'd know more about Benford later in the week.

news.h: WR Tyrell Shavers activated to 53-man roster
news.b: Buffalo activated Tyrell Shavers on Wednesday, finishing his comeback from an ACL tear suffered in last season's Wild Card game at Jacksonville. His practice window opened Oct. 28, and he is eligible to play Sunday, though Brady said a decision on his game-day status will come later. Shavers had 23 catches for 245 yards and a TD in 2025.

news.h: 'One game at a time' with Thanksgiving looming
news.b: At 8-1 and on a five-game winning streak, Josh Allen called Sunday "another opportunity to go 1-0 against a division opponent," with the Chiefs coming to town on Thanksgiving night. Ed Oliver has only one sack, but since Week 8 he ranks second in the NFL with 16 pressures and has a 23.5% pressure rate, per TruMedia.

news.h: Miami looking for a kicker; Bills 16.5-point favorites
news.b: The Dolphins (1-8) waived K Zane Gonzalez on Nov. 16, a day after he missed two field goals and an extra point in a 24-22 loss at Indianapolis. Jeff Hafley said Miami had two kickers in mind and would decide during the week. DraftKings lists Buffalo at -16.5, with a -1450 moneyline and a 45.5 total.

source: buffalobills.com Week 11 practice report and Shavers activation (Nov 18); SI/DraftKings odds (Nov 17); TSN/AP on Dolphins waiving Gonzalez (Nov 16); no AFC East games since Nov 15 (Thursday game is Colts at Texans).
